weapon.d:
Enables【Canto (Dist.; Max ３, Min １)】.
Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1).
After unit acts (if Canto triggers, after Canto), inflicts【Time's Grip】on closest foes and inflicts Spd/Res-7,【Sabotage】, and【Exposure】on closest foes and foes within 2 spaces of those foes through their next actions.
After Canto (including cases where action is ended due to Canto Control), if unit has used an Assist skill on the current turn, grants another action to unit, and re-enables Canto (once per turn; does not trigger when affected by effects of traps in Aether Raids during Canto).
Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+15 to unit, unit deals +25 damage (including area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's attacks by 15 during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and also, if unit initiates combat, unit can make a follow-up attack before foe's next attack.
【Canto (Dist.; Max ３, Min １)】
After an attack, Assist skill, or structure destruction, unit can move spaces = number of spaces from start position to end position unit moved prior to taking action (max ３; min １; if unit used a movement skill that warped them, unit can move １ space(s).)
【Time's Grip】
Inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-4 during combat. Neutralizes unit's skills during allies' combat through unit's next action.
【Sabotage】
Inflicts penalty on unit's Atk/Spd/Def/Res during combat = highest penalty on each stat between unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit. Calculates each stat penalty independently.
【Exposure】
Foe's attacks deal +10 damage.

assist.d: Target ally moves to opposite side of unit.

special.d: Boosts damage by 30% of unit's Atk.
Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Atk.

Boosts damage by X% of unit's Atk when Special triggers (if【Penalty】effects are active on foe, X = 80; otherwise, X = 70).
If unit initiates combat, reduces damage from foe's attacks by 40% during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and also, if foe has any【Penalty】effects active, grants Special cooldown count-1 to unit before unit's first attack during combat.
【Penalty】
All effects that last "on foe through its next action." Includes penalties inflicted by a skill like Panic or Threaten and negative status effects (preventing counterattacks, restricting movement, or the effects of a skill like Triangle Adept or Guard).

a.d: If unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+3 during combat.
If unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat.
If unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+5 during combat.

If unit initiates combat or is within 3 spaces of an ally, grants bonus to unit's Atk/Spd = unit's maximum Special cooldown count + 7 during combat, and also, when unit's Special triggers, deals damage = unit's maximum Special cooldown count × X (excluding area-of-effect Specials; if unit triggers the "unit attacks twice" effect, X = 3; otherwise, X = 5).

b.d:
Unit can move through foes' spaces.
If a Rally or movement Assist skill is used by unit, grants【Coax】to target ally for 1 turn.
If a Rally or movement Assist skill is used by unit or targets unit, grants Atk/Spd+6, 【Empathy】, and【Time's Gate】to unit, target or targeting ally, and allies within 2 spaces of unit and target or targeting ally after movement for 1 turn, and grants Special cooldown-1 to unit and those allies (once per turn).
For unit and allies with the【Coax】effect active on the map, deals +X damage during combat (X = highest total Atk+Spd bonuses among unit and allies with the【Coax】 effect active + 10; excluding area-of-effect Specials), and if Savior has not triggered, attacks twice during combat.
For allies with the【Empathy】effect active but without the【Coax】effect active on the map, deals +10 damage during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
Inflicts Atk/Spd/Res-5 on foes, reduces damage from foe's attacks by 15 (excluding area-of-effect Specials), neutralizes effects that guarantee foe's follow-up attacks and effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks, and grants Special cooldown charge +1 to unit per attack during combat (only highest value applied; does not stack).
【Coax】
Grants a status that can trigger certain skill effects to unit.
【Empathy】
Grants bonus to unit's Atk/Spd/Def/Res = number of types of Bonus effects, excluding stat bonuses, and Penalty effects, excluding stat penalties, active on player team and enemy team during combat (max 7).
【Time's Gate】
Allies within 4 spaces of unit can move to a space adjacent to unit (that turn only).

c.d:
If unit's HP = 100%, when Canto triggers, enables unit to use【Reposition】on ally (this effect is not treated as an Assist skill; if similar effects are active, this effect does not trigger).
【Reposition】
Range = 1. Target moves to opposite side of unit.

If unit's HP ≥ 50%, when Canto triggers, enables unit to use【Reposition】on ally (this effect is not treated as an Assist skill; if similar effects are active, this effect does not trigger).
【Reposition】
Range = 1. Target moves to opposite side of unit.

If unit's HP ≥ 25%, when Canto triggers, enables unit to use【Reposition】on ally (this effect is not treated as an Assist skill; if similar effects are active, this effect does not trigger).
【Reposition】
Range = 1. Target moves to opposite side of unit.

When Canto triggers, enables unit to use 【Reposition】on ally (this effect is not treated as an Assist skill; if similar effects are active, this effect does not trigger).
For unit and allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+4 during combat and restores 7 HP after combat.
Unit deals +5 damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials) and reduces damage from foe's first attack by 5 during combat ("first attack" normally means only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the first and second strikes).
【Reposition】
Range = 1. Target moves to opposite side of unit.
